crossRefs.note: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.
But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
“He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
“He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the…
One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.
translations.bsb: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
translations.kjv: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
